refused: firewall: --public-ports cannot be granted: something else answers on 80 or 443, so the deployment's Caddy could never take them:
- dockerd (pid 3848, uid 0) listens on 0.0.0.0:443
- your Docker's container shop-web-1 publishes 0.0.0.0:443->80/tcp, in compose project shop
- a NAT rule in table ip nat chain DOCKER: tcp dport 443 dnat to 172.18.0.2:80
Stop it, or run this site behind it with web_server.managed_by: external in the deployment's configuration, which needs no low port. Nothing was changed
